pages.title: A Bite from Nowhere
pages.text: Apply advanced tackle to an unusual catch.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Fit a Hook of the Depths and follow the fish’s journal conditions. Dimension access follows the normal game progression.

pages.title: Fish beyond water
pages.text: Lava and void fishing require suitable tackle and a configured fishing surface. A Blazing Rod has separate rules for Nether fish in other lava.
